threat_event: Theft of worker PII (SSNs, bank accounts, Form I-9 images, consumer reports) and Home Health patient data from the GWP
threat_source: Cybercriminal group; insider using a compromised staff account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One platform holds data for about 3.4 million current and former workers and 7.2 million candidates; 9,600 staff users; patient data in visit-pay records; data kept since 2014
likelihood_basis: EV-029 (3.4 million worker records and 7.2 million candidate profiles since 2014); EV-028 (9,600 staff users); EV-030 (patient data in visit-pay records); EV-015 (no SaaS bulk export rule)
existing_controls: SSO with MFA; tokenization in the payroll engine; 24x7 SOC; bulk export alerts
treatment_plan: Remove patient identifiers from visit-pay data; retention purge; tighten roles; extend egress alerts to SaaS exports

threat_event: Ransomware on the payroll engine or shared services halts pay for every division
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One payroll engine for all workers; DR tested once a year and never from immutable backups with identity assumed compromised
likelihood_basis: EV-035 (DR tested once a year; identity assumed available; no restore from the vault); EV-024 (immutable backups in provider B); EV-074 (group risk interviews)
existing_controls: Immutable backups in provider B; warm standby; EDR; PAM
treatment_plan: Isolated recovery test from immutable backups; exercise the repeat-payroll procedure; cross-division tabletop (P08)

threat_event: A shared-service incident misses one or more notice deadlines (state, E-Verify, HIPAA, client, SEC)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single notification matrix not exercised; each division and employing entity has different clocks; E-Verify notice is immediate
likelihood_basis: EV-020 (draft matrix; no notification exercise); EV-047 (an E-Verify MOU for each employing entity); EV-057 (client BAA notice terms vary)
existing_controls: Group IR plan; disclosure committee
treatment_plan: Adopt the multi-regulator matrix (P08); cross-division tabletop by 2026-12-15

threat_event: AI hiring and decision tools produce discriminatory outcomes or breach state AI laws across divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bias audit covers NYC requisitions only; no group adverse impact monitoring; Colorado and California duties from 2027-01-01 not designed; Home Health model not reviewed under 45 CFR 92.210
likelihood_basis: EV-037 (ranking add-on for all divisions; auto-advance); EV-038 (bias audit covers NYC only); EV-007 (register lacks the 2027 AI duties); EV-069 (hospitalization model inputs not reviewed)
regulatory_driver: Title VII 703(k); N56-R08 (NYC Admin. Code 20-870 et seq.); N62-R07 (45 CFR 92.210)
existing_controls: Group AI standard (2026); AI council; NYC bias audit
treatment_plan: Group AI governance program (P10): group-wide adverse impact monitoring, notices, vendor terms, 92.210 review

threat_event: Payroll diversion at scale through associate self-service and the associate service center
threat_source: Fraud rings using phished or SIM-swapped codes; social engineering
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SMS one-time code approves bank changes; no out-of-band confirmation; phone agents can change accounts after knowledge-based checks
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G4 self-service; Staffing associate service center
likelihood_basis: EV-032 (SMS code approves bank changes); EV-033 (690 diversions in 2025); EV-055 (phone changes after knowledge-based checks)
existing_controls: Bank-change email notice; fraud repayment process
treatment_plan: Passkey or app authenticator; out-of-band confirmation and a 3-day hold on first-time bank changes; fraud scoring (AI-004)

threat_event: Home Health operates outside group controls it is assumed to inherit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Supplement last aligned 2023; inheritance not documented; field tablets in a legacy tool with 72% EDR coverage
likelihood_basis: EV-063 (supplement v2023); EV-009 (no Home Health inheritance matrix); EV-017 (group EDR on 72% of tablets)
existing_controls: Group policies apply on paper; annual HIPAA risk analysis
treatment_plan: Re-issue supplement; inheritance matrix; move tablets to group endpoint management
owner: Home Health security and compliance lead

threat_event: Compromise of the group identity platform or a privileged account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One identity platform for every division; administrator phishing
likelihood_basis: EV-010 (one identity platform for every division); EV-012 (PAM and hardware keys); EV-074 (group risk interviews)
existing_controls: Hardware keys for administrators; PAM; identity threat detection
treatment_plan: Quarterly identity threat hunting; break-glass tests

threat_event: Breach of a critical workforce SaaS vendor (ATS, onboarding and I-9, credentialing, AI add-on, EHR)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendors hold most worker and candidate data; one AI vendor has no SOC 2 report
likelihood_basis: EV-040 (SOC 2 reports on file; none for the AI vendor); EV-039 (vendor tiering)
existing_controls: Tiered vendor reviews; SOC 2 reports for most vendors
treatment_plan: Continuous monitoring of tier 1 vendors; breach notice terms in every contract

threat_event: E-Verify account misuse leads to an MOU violation across employing entities
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 1,400 E-Verify users outside SSO; 52 departed-user accounts found in 2026 Q2
likelihood_basis: EV-047 (about 1,400 E-Verify users outside SSO); EV-084 (52 departed-user accounts in the 2026 Q2 review)
existing_controls: Quarterly E-Verify user review
treatment_plan: E-Verify users on the termination checklist; monthly reconciliation to HR; named-account attestation

threat_event: Home Health patient data is disclosed to corporate payroll without BAA coverage or minimum-necessary limits
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Visit-pay interface built in 2024 without privacy review; intercompany BAA does not cover payroll
likelihood_basis: EV-030 (visit-pay feed since 2024-04 with no privacy review); EV-031 (no PIA); EV-005 (BAA does not list payroll)
existing_controls: Payroll users are bound by group confidentiality terms
treatment_plan: Anonymous visit IDs; purge historical identifiers; amend the intercompany BAA to cover any residual data

threat_event: Materiality of a cyber incident is decided late or wrongly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Disclosure playbook not exercised with a cross-division scenario; no method for worker remediation cost estimates
likelihood_basis: EV-006 (no cross-division disclosure exercise; no remediation cost method)
existing_controls: Disclosure committee charter covers cybersecurity
treatment_plan: Exercise the playbook in the 2026-12 tabletop; cost model per affected worker

threat_event: Detection gaps let an intrusion run undetected in division systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Home Health EHR and tablet telemetry and the VMS tenant logs are not in the SIEM
likelihood_basis: EV-015 (Home Health EHR, tablet and VMS logs not in the SIEM)
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC for onboarded sources
treatment_plan: Onboard Home Health and VMS logs

threat_event: An attacker pivots from unsegmented branch kiosks into the staff network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Kiosks on the staff network at 61 legacy branches
likelihood_basis: EV-051 (kiosks on the staff network at 61 legacy branches)
existing_controls: EDR on kiosks; SD-WAN segmentation at 329 branches
treatment_plan: Segment the 61 branches

threat_event: Over-retention of candidate and worker data enlarges any breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No automated deletion for candidates, consumer reports, or visit-pay records; data since 2014
likelihood_basis: EV-044 (no automated deletion; data since 2014)
existing_controls: Retention schedule approved 2025
treatment_plan: Automated deletion jobs per record type; one-time purge

threat_event: Managed Workforce Solutions clients leave for lack of a SOC 2 report
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 31 MSP client contracts require a SOC 2 Type 2 report by 2027-12-31
likelihood_basis: EV-053 (31 contracts require a SOC 2 Type 2 report by 2027-12-31)
existing_controls: Client questionnaires answered from P03 and P07
treatment_plan: SOC 2 readiness and first Type 2 period (P09)

threat_event: Consultant access to client systems leads to a client PHI breach attributed to the group
threat_source: Departed consultant; attacker using lingering client accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 6,300 client-issued accounts not inventoried; client PHI in the document repository
likelihood_basis: EV-058 (client-issued accounts not inventoried); EV-059 (no classification labels); EV-092 (client PHI in engagement folders)
existing_controls: Client BAAs; consultant training
treatment_plan: Client account register; roll-off notices within 1 business day; repository classification

threat_event: Federal Solutions loses contract eligibility over a safeguarding failure
threat_source: Audit finding or incident in the enclave
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Enclave patching lag in 2026 Q2
likelihood_basis: EV-060 (monthly enclave patching); EV-076 (slower patching in 2026 Q2)
existing_controls: Isolated enclave; annual self-assessment
treatment_plan: Patch within 30 days; monthly enclave compliance report

threat_event: Insider misuse of payroll or HR data by staff
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9,600 staff users; broad recruiter views in some regions
likelihood_basis: EV-028 (9,600 staff users; export rights); EV-075 (broad recruiter views in some regions)
existing_controls: Role-based access; sanctions; bulk export alerts
treatment_plan: Quarterly role reviews; user behavior analytics on GWP logs

threat_event: A hurricane disrupts Florida headquarters, payroll and onboarding centers, and Home Health agencies at once
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Headquarters and largest operations in Florida; Home Health in 5 southeastern states
likelihood_basis: EV-050 (largest center in Florida); EV-062 (5 coastal southeastern states); EV-074 (hurricane impacts)
existing_controls: Second payroll and onboarding center in another state; emergency plans
treatment_plan: Joint hurricane and cyber outage exercise each year

threat_event: A future acquisition brings an unintegrated environment into the group
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integration playbook not updated after the Home Health experience
likelihood_basis: EV-074 (integration playbook not updated since the Home Health acquisition); EV-001 (Home Health acquired 2023)
existing_controls: Pre-close security diligence
treatment_plan: Integration playbook with a 12-month control inheritance deadline
